params.name: begin
params.description: Only invoices created at or after this date-time will be included (format: HTML5 datetime-local, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: end
params.description: Only invoices created before or at this date-time will be included (format: HTML5 datetime-local, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: customers[]
params.description: List of customer IDs to filter, e.g.: customers[]=1&customers[]=2

params.name: status[]
params.description: Invoice status: pending, paid, canceled, new. Default: all

params.name: page
params.description: The page to display, renders a 404 if not found (default: 1)

params.name: size
params.description: The amount of entries for each page (default: 50)
